BiblicalUsage: En-Gannim is a place in Palestine. In Joshua 15:34, the text says "and En-gannim." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Gannim matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Gannim is one of them.
